summary: Translation extension for Log/History/SOS/Caregivers/Caregiver-view verified in Nyanja + Bemba/Tonga spot checks + English toggle-back. 100% of expected translated strings matched exactly on Log, History, SOS, Caregivers screens. caregiver-view.tsx uses t(contextLabels[g.context] || g.context) which correctly translates glucose context chips in history list; same pattern reused on history.tsx.

sos.tsx uses t('go to the nearest hospital or dial') + '991' + t('(Zambia national emergency) immediately.') split string — currently works but may produce awkward word order in some languages; non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all tested strings matched; caregiver-view not visually re-verified)

seed_data_creation: Generated one 7-day caregiver invite code (MZOW2NRS) from primary test user during testing; may already be accepted/expired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App shows an onboarding carousel (testIDs: onb-skip / onb-next) AFTER a successful first login — must call it 'post-login'; tap onb-skip once to proceed to home. Login testIDs: auth-phone-input, auth-passcode-input, auth-submit-button. Settings has testIDs lang-en/lang-ny/lang-bem/lang-toi.
